serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I will do it. I don’t think it's a good thing to do, but for you to be bound to her against your will is just too cruel.
You: We are friends now, and if I can improve your life with this, I will do it.
You: It’s done…
Real Melissa: Aghhh…{{wi}} Aghh…{{wi}} Ack…
#Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.happyAlt
Amei: Thank you…
#Cashier.Eyes.happy+Cashier.Mouth.happyAlt
Amei: With this. I can finally end this pain.
Amei: Don’t worry, I put some contingencies in place so that what happens next won’t hurt {f_botName} and Annalie.
You: What do you mean? You are scaring me…
#Cashier.Eyes.depressed+Cashier.Mouth.happyAlt
Amei: The time I spent with you all was really nice, but it’s a constant reminder of what I lost, of what I did…
Amei: Annalie…{{wi}} She reminds me of Melissa so much… It hurts just to look at her…
Amei: And whenever I see you and {f_botName} I see the people I killed…
Amei: You are very kind and I’m sorry for deceiving you, but…{{wi}} I really can’t live like this…
#Cashier.animate(MoveToLeft)
As she was saying this, Amei came closer to the window…
You: What are you talking about? Hey! What do you mean by deceived?!
Amei: Don’t you know? Bots are illegal, and if their master is gone, they need to follow the next command in line.
Amei: This is what I wanted all along. To execute the self-destruction command sent by the government to every bot when they became illegal.
You: Stop!
#Cashier.animate(MoveToLeft)
Amei: Don’t worry. A fall from this height will for sure destroy my memory circuit.
You: That’s not what I meant! 
Amei: I know, you are very kind, after all. 
You: What am I supposed to tell {f_botName} and Annalie?! You can’t do this to them!
Amei: It should be alright. You should receive a message soon.
Amei: Goodbye. {{wi}}And thank you.
